Explanation:
The actual costs can vary depending on the investment period which depends on several factors
and the performance of the product. The Simulation does not account for any expected performance
or return on investment as it assumes that the prices of the financial instruments in which the
portfolio is invested remain constant. In order to calculate the cumulative effect of the total costs
and charges on the investment return, you may deduct this total amount from your return.
Depending on the instrument, transaction-related taxes may apply.
9 Entry service costs include handling fees and brokerage fees, third-party correspondent
brokerage and settlement fees. Amounts may vary in function of markets and counterparties, and
are not always known in advance. For simulation purposes, we include amounts based on the
average costs per market and on the standard fee schedule for the specific client’s account. For
some financial instruments traded over-the-counter (OTC), a spread is charged instead of
brokerage fees. Exceptionally, for certain OTC derivatives (for example, some exotic options), you
may be charged up to 9% of the investment amount. Where a transaction in a financial instrument
leads to a currency conversion, you are charged a brokerage fee on the financial instrument, and a
spread on the foreign exchange transaction. Information on these costs may be found in the Private
Banking Fee Schedule and its Addendum.
9 / 9 Entry / exit costs and charges charged at the discretion of the product manufacturers.
9 Annual service costs include advisory (if applicable), administration fees, third-party custody
charges and VAT, where applicable.
9 Instrument costs during investment include on-going costs, transaction costs related to the
issuance and management of financial instruments and incidental costs. Some structured
products, such as certificates, have other specific inherent instrument costs. Private equity and
real estate funds are subject to special conditions. Information on the fees related to these funds
can be found in the Alternative Investments Fee Schedule. The costs and associated charges
related to the issuance and management of financial instruments are calculated on a best effort
basis using data and information available from product manufacturers and reliable financial data
providers.
9 In principle, exit service costs are equal to entry service costs described in point 9. Some
financial instruments, such as bonds, structured products and derivatives, do not carry any exit
costs if held until maturity. Other instruments such as options carry additional exit costs if
exercised at maturity.
9 To standardize information, investment period is assumed to be 9 & 9 years except if the
instrument has a specific maturity
9 The total transaction costs and the costs of the financial instrument (if applicable) have a direct
impact on the return of the investment. If this financial instrument is bought, held and resold over
a 99-month period, the performance is reduced by the costs shown in the table. With a longer
holding period of, for example, three years, the annual cost effect on the return is reduced.

conditions.
